title: 5 AI tools gamers are using to get unfair advantages

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know some gamers are using AI to cheat in real-time?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This is changing how fair and competitive online games are.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: One tool, called Aim Buddy, uses AI to predict enemy movements.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It analyzes thousands of game frames per second to aim perfectly.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Top players and streamers are using it to win tournaments.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The real issue? It's making the game unfair for honest players.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you ever seen someone aim that perfectly in a match?

caption_text: 5 AI tools gamers are using to get unfair advantages
